name: Ahagon Umiko
source: The chief of the programming team at Eagle Jump who is from Okinawa. She is a huge military fan, collects all kinds of model guns and enjoys playing airsoft a lot - to the point where she even carries an airsoft gun around the office. She hates it when people call her by her last name, "Ahagon" because it sounds like "Ahegao".
